name: ai.gtinfetch/gtinfetch
title: gtinfetch – Agentic Commerce
description: 84M GTINs. Five calls on one MCP: resolve, verify, locate, identify, prove. x402 at the door.

tools.name: match_product
tools.description: Resolve. Call this when you hold words, not a barcode: a shopper's phrase ("the big jar of Nutella") or a merchant's offer line, and a country. Returns one barcode (Global Trade Item Number, GTIN) with a confidence when the record holds exactly one product for the words, otherwise the candidates, otherwise unknown. Never a guess. This is the matcher at matchfetch.ai, answered here under its own name; issue_receipt: true writes a signed receipt. Once you hold the barcode, call fetch_gtin to verify it.

words.description: the phrase or the offer line

country.description: two-letter country, e.g. UK, FR, DE, US

tools.name: fetch_gtin
tools.description: What is this GTIN? Returns the signed record for a GTIN-8/12/13/14: product, brand, maker, category and pack where a source page states them, each with the pages it was read from and the date it was read; seen_in markets and banners; confidence confirmed (two or more independent domains agree) or seen (one). A GTIN with no observation answers status unknown with no fields — never a guess. Pass market (hub market code; UK accepted for GB) to tag the ask with the market: a miss is queued as a lead for that market. Can it be sold there is the hub's gate, not this door's. Extended 2026-11-13: every answer also carries answer (verified · not verified · unknown, by the published rule at https://gtinfetch.ai/rule.json), reason, facts with the variant facts (size, pack count, type), facts_compared, sources_read (each source with its last-read date), rule_version and region. Optional inputs: market (used for the recall check), believes {brand, product, size} (what you believe you are buying), receipt (true writes a signed receipt of the check in the same call at https://rco.wefetch.ai/; anyone can check it at https://rco-barcodeverified.org/verify). A barcode-only call returns everything it returned before, with the new fields beside the old.

market.description: optional hub market code, e.g. UK, US, FR

believes.description: optional: what the agent believes it is buying, as the agent holds it. Checked against the record; facts_compared says what was checked and what could not be.

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/. The answer is always given; the receipt is what is paid for.

tools.name: locate
tools.description: Locate. Call this when you hold a barcode and need to know where the product is sold. Returns the retail banners and the markets where the barcode is on the record as sold, each with the source page it was read on (where the record holds one) and the date it was read, and each banner's page on identifyfetch.ai. Never price, never stock: for those, ask the retailer. An empty list means the record holds no place of sale, not that the product is not sold. Read from the same signed record as fetch_gtin.

market.description: optional market code, e.g. UK, US, FR: used for the recall check and to tag the ask

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/

tools.name: identify
tools.description: Identify. Call this when you hold a barcode and need to know which company is behind it: who makes it, who sells it, and whether the company has claimed its record. Returns the maker as the record names it and the retail banners that sell it, each with its page on identifyfetch.ai and its status: listed (on the record from public sources), claimed (the company's agent has proved control of the company's own domain) or verified. Companies only: no person is named. Where the record names no maker, maker is null and the brand is given; a brand is not a company. Read from the same signed record as fetch_gtin.

market.description: optional market code, e.g. UK, US, FR

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Prove. Call this when you hold a receipt number or id (rc_… or pm_…) for a check and need the record that it was made: the receipt, its hash, its signature and its place in the chain, checked in public. This is the receipts door at rco.wefetch.ai, answered here under its own name. To have a receipt written, pass receipt: true on fetch_gtin, locate or identify (issue_receipt: true on match_product).
